name: cmdb_cientity_transaction
label: CMDB Configuration Item Instance Transaction Table
description: The CMDB configuration item instance transaction table is used for related queries in configuration management and other reporting scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: ci_id
fields.description: Reference the ID from the ecmdb_ci. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: ci_entity_id
fields.description: Retrieve the ID from the ecmdb_ci_entity table. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Operation type, I: insert, U: update, D: delete, S: recover.

fields.name: transaction_id
fields.description: Transaction ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Update the content, in JSON format.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_NewIndex1
indexes.description: Standard index covering the transaction_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_NewIndex2
indexes.description: Standard index covering the ci_entity_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_NewIndex3
indexes.description: Standard index covering the ci_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
